Zodiac Developers Private Limited, an associate company included in the consolidated financial statements, is engaged in a real estate project at Hanuman Nagar that is currently subject to litigation. A dispute has arisen with the Joint Developer in respect of this project. An arbitration award dated 15 October 2020 was passed against the associate company, which management believes is inconsistent with the guidelines and instructions issued by the Slum Rehabilitation Authority (SRA). The associate company has challenged the award by filing an application under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 before the Hon'ble Bombay High Court. Pursuant to this application, the company has obtained a stay on the execution of the award through an order dated 26 April 2023. Based on legal advice and the developments in the matter, management is of the view that the expenditure incurred on the project is recoverable. They further expect that future sales and recoveries from the project will generate positive cash flows.
Emphasis of Matter: Associate company wrote off amount due from Akshar Group (originally paid in FY 2017-18) following arbitration award in FY 2024-25; opinion not modified.

Other Matter: Consolidated financial statements include Parent's share of net profit of Rs. 11.94 lakhs for year ended March 31, 2026 from two associate companies audited by other auditors; opinion not modified.
